newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Feb trade seen at 300 mln rgt surplus.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Feb trade seen at 300 mln rgt surplus.

text.p: Malaysia's trade balance in February showed a surplus of around 300 million ringgit, informed market sources said on Tuesday.
The Statistics Department is expected to release the report at around noon local time (0400 GMT) on Tuesday.
But market sources said they understood the balance was a trade surplus of at least 300 million ringgit and as much as 370 million ringgit.
In January, Malaysia reported a 95.5 million ringgit trade deficit.
